evidence: Changes the return types and interfaces of CreateNewBlock and CreateNewTemplate in src/node/miner.h and src/node/block_template_manager.h.
rationale: Clarifies template construction interfaces by replacing nullable pointers with NotNullUniquePtr and removing dead null checks. As noted in review, 'CreateNewBlock can't return null' and typing it as such eliminates dead branches, but it is an internal developer cleanup that does not affect template validity, performance, or miner-facing behavior.
